intro: It is your first day at work. Introduce yourself to the manager.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Welcome! You must be our new team member.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Introduce yourself and say it is your first day.
expected: Yes, I am Arjun. It is my first day.
Hello, my name is Arjun. Today is my first day.
Yes, this is my first day.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, I am Arjun. It is my first day."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Nice to meet you. Where are you from?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: I am from a small town near Delhi.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Wonderful. Have you worked in an office before?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Answer whether you have worked before.
expected: No, this is my first job.
Yes, I worked in an office before.
No, I have not worked before.
conversation.hint: Try: "No, this is my first job."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Do not worry, we will help you learn. Your desk is by the window.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask what your first task is.
expected: What would you like me to do?

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Read these papers this morning, then we will talk again.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you will do your best.
expected: Thank you, I will do my best.
